title: Figure 32. f-Ratios for Ranges from 1 to 25 Miles (line graph)
description: Line graph plotting f-Ratio (0–300) against Angular Deviation From Downrange (deg), 0–180, for A = 3.0 and B = 1000. Four curves represent R = 1, 5, 10 and 25 nm. Text explains a vehicle with a Mode-5 response is about 60 times more likely to impact along the flight line than along the 90-degree radial at 10 miles. Captioned "Figure 32. f-Ratios for Ranges from 1 to 25 Miles".
